proposal.summary: PandoraFMS 7.0 NG (<= 746) contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that can be triggered by having a network administrator scan an SNMP device; the report demonstrates loading a remote JavaScript which is used to create a plugin and achieve remote code execution on the server.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Sanitize or validate SNMP-provided fields before rendering in the web UI; in the short term, restrict admins from viewing SNMP-originated device metadata, and update PandoraFMS to a version that removes this XSS. Also review and remove any injected plugins and rotate credentials.
